name: lollipop
title: Lollipop
description: A ranked list with thin stems and round heads at each value: sort by value or name and the rows slide into place; one Tab stop with arrow keys, a tooltip per row, and the list itself is the data for screen readers.

props.name: data
props.description: One entry per row, in any order: `{ label, value, details? }`.

props.name: label
props.description: What the list shows, such as "Top merchants by spend, last 30 days". Names the list.

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the rows, the tooltip and on the axis.

props.name: sort
props.description: "value" puts the largest first, "label" sorts by name, "none" keeps the order of `data`. Default "value".

props.name: limit
props.description: Show only the largest n rows. Default all.

props.name: axis
props.description: Show the value ticks under the list. Default true.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: The highlighted row (an index into `data`), or null for none. Pass it to control the highlight.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: The highlighted row on first render when uncontrolled. Default null.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called when the highlight moves by pointer, focus or keys, with null when it clears.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a row is clicked or pressed with Enter or Space, with its index into `data`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show breathing skeleton rows instead of data.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in place of the rows when there is no data or every value is 0, such as a message and a next step.

props.name: density
props.description: "compact" tightens the rows and columns. Inside a compact DataTile this happens on its own.
